Cumq; tardiora ingenia, solâ arte & labore; leviora autem, solo prope naturæ instinctu, nomen & commendationem sibi concilient: huic tertiæ animorum formæ accidit, ut industria & arte mediocriillustrentur. Quotquot in hanc classem divertunt & commorantur, ad artes ingenuas, maximè ad eloquentiam, tum verò ad politiam optimè constituendam, apprimè nati sunt.

Ingenia mediocriter tarda qui noscantur.5. Ingeniis mediocriter tardis omnes illæ enumeratæ dotes, & aliquid adhuc inhæret robustius. Enimverò in his natura cum arte, industria cum labore, meditatio cum solertiâ, prudentia cùm tolerantiâ, certant æqualiter, & sibi mutuam lucem & commendationem adferunt.
6. Ingenia heroïca inveniendis rebus novis & administrandis arduis sunt omnium ap-tissima.

page.notes: The Latin in the first line and the abbreviation after "inserviendum" are uncertain. The "q" mark is a superscript sign, read as -que, and is marked [?]. "mediocriillustrentur" appears run together in the print and is copied as printed. The initial E is a large drop cap, joined to "Narratæ" as in the print. The marginal note is printed in small type across three lines with hyphens at the line ends, kept as printed. The heading's "Schola" carries a circumflex on the a, copied as printed.
